name: Full Hunnyween 2023 Set
description:
Happy Hunnyween! This is the ULTIMATE Hunnyween set for all lovers of cool weather, Spooky Season, cute costumes, Halloween, and Fashion Shows. 


This single token automatically unlocks all 31 items in the Hunnyween 2023 Set, available immediately for use in the [Hunnys Closet](https://closet.hunnys.io).

Owning this unlocks the following set of Hunnys Closet items from Hunnyween 2023:

Bodysuit: Bunny Fighter Costume



Hair Style: Medusa Hair



All pieces purchased within this Hunnys Closet Shop collection will immediately unlock the specified item(s) for use in the Hunnys Closet.

As long as you currently hold this token in the same wallet that you are connected with when using the Hunnys Closet, it will automatically be available for use - enjoy!
